body_markdown:
**Allient Inc. Achieves Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2**


[Download printer-friendly version](https://allient.com/d/?h=54aa067)


**Buffalo, N.Y. – 29 September, 2026 –** Allient Inc. (Nasdaq: ALNT) (“Allient” or the “Company”), a global designer and manufacturer of specialty Motion, Controls, Power and Composite Solutions achieved Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2, effective August 27, 2026.


CMMC Level 2 is a U.S. Department of Defense cybersecurity standard that verifies an organization's ability to protect Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) through the implementation of 110 rigorous security controls and processes. The CMMC Level 2 assessment was conducted by Cybersecurity Investments, the C3PAO for this engagement, and the certification is valid for three years.


This certification demonstrates Allient’s ongoing commitment to cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and safeguarding the sensitive information entrusted to us by our customers and partners. Achieving this milestone reflects the dedication and hard work of teams across the organization and strengthens our ability to support current and future defense-related business opportunities.


“CMMC Level 2 is an important milestone for Allient and reflects the high priority we place on maintaining strong cybersecurity practices across the organization,” said Steve Warzala, President of Allient Defense. “Protecting sensitive information is an imperative responsibility, and this certification demonstrates our continued focus on maintaining the cybersecurity practices needed to support our customers.”


For more information about Allient’s certifications, visit[here](https://allient.com/certifications/) .


**ABOUT ALLIENT INC.**


Allient (Nasdaq: ALNT) is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction, and facility infrastructure. A family of globally responsible companies, Allient takes a One-Team approach to “Connect What Matters” and provides the most robust, reliable, and high-value products and systems by utilizing its core Motion, Controls, and Power technologies and platforms.


Headquartered in Buffalo, N.Y., Allient employs more than 2,500 team members around the world.
